text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was thinking Inari One wasn't 
going to show up—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Boss! I'm late! I've got no excuse!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Sis! I'm late! I've got no excuse!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"No takin' it back now! Not makin' excuses 
is the true Edokko way!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! They're such a mature, bigger 
person! Compared to them, I'm just...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm real sorry! I'll go wash my face in 
miso soup and start over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I never found out why she was 
late, but she seemed deeply apologetic, so 
I decided to forgive her.
